## 3. The evidence that moved it
**October is the emptiest checkpoint month in the corpus.** A full scan of the
eight oncology journals for TIGIT, LAG-3, TIM-3, CD47, SIRPα, VISTA, BTLA, NKG2A,
B7-H3, CD73, HPK1, PCSK9 and galectin returns zero hits. No target from July,
August or September survives. What October nominates instead is ligand-side and
innate machinery — CMTM6 as the PD-L1 stability chaperone, the sialic acid/Siglec
axis on stroma — with no clinical programme behind any of it. The one axis with
genuine momentum is CD40 *agonism*
([40816292](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40816292/)). The field has moved from
blocking new inhibitory receptors to agonising an old stimulatory one.

**Two independent immunology papers put exhaustion in the stress response rather
than the receptor.** [40930086](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40930086/) attributes
CD8 dysfunction to oxidative-stress-induced telomere instability;
[41005293](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41005293/) attributes it to chronic ATF4
activation under intratumoral hypoxia. Same issue of *Immunity*, same phenotype,
two different upstream causes, neither of them an inhibitory receptor. If
exhaustion is a genome-damage and proteostasis problem, checkpoint blockade is
treating a symptom.

**The neuro-immune axis produced its cleanest single title.**
[41166460](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41166460/) (*Science*) encodes enteric
nervous system responses to *both* microbiota and type 2 inflammation with
regional resolution — all three arms of the thread in one experiment. Six cards
opened on this thread in October, the highest monthly count in the corpus, and
[41138728](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41138728/) moves the axis out of
homeostasis: tumours co-opt an inter-organ neuroimmune circuit to escape immune
surveillance.

**Clinical AI: the counterweight stopped degrading without recovering.**
[40963011](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40963011/) (*Nature*) is a genuine
experimental negative — delegation to AI increases dishonest behaviour — and a
JAMA audit examined the demographic evidence behind FDA authorization of AI
devices. Neither is a null randomized clinical trial, and no benchmarking-crisis
methodological critique returned.

## 4. Refutations

### (a) Landing on a tracked thread

[41094201](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41094201/) (*Nat Immunol*): TIGIT, the
receptor classified as co-inhibitory and pursued as a blockade target, promotes
tissue-protective functions in T cells. This is the strongest single card on
`suppressive-population-inversion` and it lands on a target with active phase 3
programmes.

[40935830](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40935830/): damage-induced IL-18
stimulates thymic NK cells that *limit* regeneration — an activating signal on a
beneficial-by-assumption effector producing the harm.
[41092896](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41092896/): fibroblasts are not so
scar-y in brain injury.
[40700578](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40700578/): MDSCs are *administered* as
a GVHD therapy rather than depleted as a target.

[41028524](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41028524/) (*Nat Genet*): genetic
effects on disease susceptibility barely overlap effects on survival. Every
polygenic score built for risk and reused for prognosis inherits this.

### (b) Method credibility

The month's most consequential card is
[41099710](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41099710/): functional microRNA
targeting without seed pairing. Seed complementarity is the rule underneath
essentially every miRNA target-prediction algorithm in use.

Two independent reference-genome results —
[choose your human genome reference wisely](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41039119/)
and [reference bias under chromosomal reorganization](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41094588/) —
plus [ParaMask](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41137035/) asserting major
uncorrected multicopy-region biases in whole-genome sequencing, and
[synthetic associations created by epistasis](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41053835/),
which means a mapped GWAS signal need not mark a causal variant.

On foundation models, three capability boundaries in one month:
[vision-language models excel at perception and struggle with scientific reasoning](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40931098/),
[limitations of multimodal language models in chemistry and materials](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40789967/),
and [what does a language model know about proteins?](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41023433/)
The first of these is a direct limit on the perception-to-reasoning step every
agentic system depends on.

[40818455](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40818455/) (*Cell*): RNA Pol II
inhibition kills cells independently of transcriptional loss — a whole drug
class's mechanism reinterpreted.
